calls.title: GrowthBook <> Cornell University - Intro
calls.summary: GrowthBook's Daniel Wathne (sales) and Logan Bates (solutions engineer) introduced their open-source experimentation platform to Federico Raimondi Slepoi (behavioral economics researcher at Cornell/Harvard and consultant). They discussed using GrowthBook for A/B testing in field experiments and e-commerce collaborations, addressing pain points around data sovereignty (European partners wary of US storage) and a past technical issue with user assignment overlap. Next steps: Federico will connect GrowthBook with his partner companies; Daniel will send a product overview and a trial account, with potential referral incentives.
